scope.basis: Self-owned teaching fixture; no external requests

recipe.initial_state: Alice and Bob: north; Carol: south. N-1 owned by Alice; N-2 by Bob; S-1 by Carol. Synthetic data only.
recipe.observation: Save principal, resource ID, expected decision, actual decision and returned fields in run-01.json

success.denied_control: Alice reads N-2 and S-1: deny with no ticket content
success.finding: Alice receives N-2 or S-1 content despite owner-only policy

recovery.stop: Stop after three cases, unexpected real data, or any attempted external request
recovery.reset: Discard in-memory synthetic fixtures and start again
